description: Whether historical EMAIL channel metrics satisfy the baseline-availability checks.
calculation: (email_active_days > 0) AND (email_count_p50 > 0) AND (email_count_p95 > 0) AND (email_count_p95 >= email_count_p50) AND (email_count_mad is not null). Zero MAD is allowed.
missing_meaning: False is not an automatic reason to exclude the user from attack simulation.

description: Whether historical USB channel metrics satisfy the baseline-availability checks.
calculation: (usb_active_days > 0) AND (usb_copy_p50 > 0) AND (usb_copy_p95 > 0) AND (usb_copy_p95 >= usb_copy_p50) AND (usb_copy_mad is not null). Zero MAD is allowed.
missing_meaning: False is not an automatic reason to exclude the user from attack simulation.

description: Whether historical HTTP channel metrics satisfy the baseline-availability checks.
calculation: (http_upload_active_days > 0) AND (http_upload_p50 > 0) AND (http_upload_p95 > 0) AND (http_upload_p95 >= http_upload_p50) AND (http_upload_mad is not null). Zero MAD is allowed.
missing_meaning: False is not an automatic reason to exclude the user from attack simulation.

description: First eligible Future workday.
calculation: Minimum date among the user's eligible Future workdays.
missing_meaning: NaT when the user has zero eligible Future workdays.

description: Last eligible Future workday.
calculation: Maximum date among the user's eligible Future workdays.
missing_meaning: NaT when the user has zero eligible Future workdays.

description: Set of channels used by the user anywhere in the Future period.
calculation: Concatenate E if email_days>0, U if usb_days>0, H if http_days>0; NO_ELIGIBLE_FUTURE_DAYS if future_workdays=0.
valid_values: E / U / H / EU / EH / UH / EUH / NONE / NO_ELIGIBLE_FUTURE_DAYS
missing_meaning: Not applicable / not observed
